title: Design Services for New Construction and Renovation
short_description: Design services framework for future college new construction and renovation projects.
project_scope: Professional design services for future new construction and renovation projects at Stark State College. Individual project scopes are not defined in the notice. Stated total construction cost range per project or package: USD 250,000 to USD 2,000,000.
services: A/E or stand-alone engineering services including architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style solicitation for unspecified future projects, which is generally low priority for sbp.
- Includes structural and civil engineering, but no defined bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Target market is a college campus, which can be relevant in principle, but the notice lacks any concrete building or structural challenge.
- Broad multidisciplinary A/E scope suggests general campus projects rather than a specific technically demanding structure.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as a stated total construction cost range of USD 250,000 to USD 2,000,000; exact project-specific cost is not defined.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. Only a construction cost range of USD 250,000 to USD 2,000,000 is provided, and the solicitation covers unspecified future projects across multiple disciplines, so a realistic sbp fee cannot be derived.
references_qualifications: Professional design services for A/E or stand-alone engineering projects; requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil, electrical, mechanical, and structural engineering. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice.
contracting_authority: Stark State College, 6200 Frank Ave. NW, North Canton, OH 44720, USA. Contact: Kevin D. Gardner. Phone: 330-494-6170. Fax: 330-996-6594. Email: sspradling@starkstate.edu. Website/document source noted: http://ofcc.ohio.gov
notes: Notice describes future unspecified projects rather than a single defined project. Funding source: state or local. Solicitation documents available by contact. The source labels this as design services for new construction and renovation at a university/college campus.
